_about: Available games (ALL_GAMES, C-21) that do not save their game with createSessionStore (C-6; tools/agents/memory.mjs, #1249 step 12), each { id, reason }. An entry whose game now uses it fails memory.test.mjs as stale: remove it. The games built in cup/games/ came in frozen when the check was extended to every game (D-542): a ratchet, it only shrinks.

entries.reason: La Copa is a tournament of days, not a game in progress: its state lives on the server (the cup, its days and each player's results), so there is nothing on the phone to resume; each day's game is a Cup game with its own rules

Built in cup/games/: its attempt is kept by the Cup's shared screen (public/cup/cuenta.js, per cup, day and player, which does not use createSessionStore because a day outlasts its 12 hours), not by its own code
